origin: Authorized read-only copy from the user Jetson BusTracker directory

extraction.method: First sample after passed-point ID changes; split duplicate-point loops and gaps over 8 minutes
extraction.arrivalQuality: Passage-time proxy; boarding service at each point is not field-validated
extraction.walking: Candidate point pairs within 100m; lengths from local OSM pedestrian graph, not surveyed paths; disconnected pairs excluded
extraction.roadGeometry: Local OSM road matching constrained by recorded GPS; no external GPS transmission; see road-geometry.json
extraction.uncertainty: Synthetic delay samples, not fitted or calibrated to historical prediction errors

warning: A replay loop is not a new independent calendar day. The recording is not a current official timetable.
